answer: Winter comes and the store must hold, so every piece in it is counted twice before the snow. Proof of rope maker coil via rope makers guild counts the store: a coil the rope makers guild lays only after the maker twists a yarn he actually spun. The vertex is the first count, made when the piece was finished; the echo is the second, made when it was stored. To fill a false store a cheat must invent 17 pieces and 17 makers to vouch for them, and the signal stays empty where the real pieces should be.
